INFINITE CONQUEST — Alpha 0.5.0
A hex & allies strategy game: Zeus clashes with Poseidon for the mortal world.

NO INSTALL NEEDED — HOW TO PLAY
  Double-click "Play Infinite Conquest.vbs".
  (Java is bundled inside the jre folder, so nothing else is required.)

WHAT'S INSIDE
  Play Infinite Conquest.vbs ... launches the game (no console window)
  app\ ........................ game files
  jre\ ........................ bundled Java 17 runtime (trimmed, Windows x64)

SAVED DATA
  Decks, settings, and saved games live in your user folder:
    %USERPROFILE%\.infinite-conquest\

TROUBLESHOOTING
  - If Windows SmartScreen warns about the .vbs file, choose "Run anyway".
    (This is normal for unsigned alpha builds.)
  - The game needs a 64-bit Windows 10/11 PC.

Created by Mathew Rice. Thanks for playing.
